scientific_integrity: All graph exposures and nonedges are proved symbolically; the numerical profile counts are exact integer checks but do not constitute independent validation.
scientific_limitations: The theorem treats complete transitively oriented three-layer digraphs only. It is not a general formula for arbitrary directed graphs or higher-dimensional faces. The universal proof is analytic; finite checks are corroborative. Earlier broad face theorems may enable specialized derivations, and priority has not been externally adjudicated.
title: Origin-deletion edge births in three-layer directed root polytopes
